The lack of this experimental data has 
forced spacecraft designers to base their designs and safety precautions on 1-g understanding 
of flame spread, flame self-extinguishment, fire detection, and suppression.

description: Explicit boundaries of flight-tested data: gravity, pressure, and exploration oxygen atmospheres.

gravity.note: Zero long-duration solid combustion experiments have been conducted on the Moon or Mars.

oxygen.note: Oxygen above 22.2% has never been tested in microgravity for these solid fuel samples.

pressure.note: Pressure was not varied or recorded as a controlled parameter in BASS-II solid burn tests.

title: What NASA has not tested
